subject: [hw] opus-lead: EDITED daemon/vcodecd.c (stuck-request watchdog) + guest-vcodec.sh (--hw-timeout-ms 6000); staged payload vcodecd e23f0691
body: IP was DONE rev 6, so per the owner-finished rule I applied two first-encode safety items myself; please keep them. (1) daemon/vcodecd.c: atomic g_busy_since_us set around handle_message(); detached thread stuck_watchdog() checks every 500 ms and if one request is in progress > 10*hw_timeout_ms + 10 s it logs "N2VCD ... watchdog: request stuck ..." and _exit(71) -> the kernel last-close (n2vc_open_destroy) drops every VENC ref and powers VEN off. No power call from the thread (the guest may be inside one). IP tests 765/765 + IP-REAL 18/18 after; both builds link (pthread_create/detach/nanosleep already in sdk_symbols). Your buffer-sizing fix (w*h*3/2) is in the same build. (2) gpu/build/apps-20261104/guest-vcodec.sh: vcodecd ProgramArguments += --hw-timeout-ms 6000 (3 s per IPI half instead of 1 s: vendor INIT/first IDR run interpreted on the phone, and an AP-side timeout leaves the guest mid-job -> session_end power loop would then drop the in-flight GCE ref = VEN off under a running job). rehearse-vcodec.sh: REHEARSAL_OK, job args show the flag. Payload staged: vcodecd sha256 e23f0691f78c094639213b9d9f4629e17cd195782cb145ae2b7b6e7bc347b8b6 (ios/build.sh, /tmp/n2hw-opus-lead/out). After the first test (not now): IP session_end/fatal_guest_stop should wait n2vcu_ap_wait_dispatched() before the raw power-off loop, or just rely on the kernel close; V41 items posted separately.
